title: Improve conditional kappa to 0.003021569 with helper621 and a funded compiler gap
body:
Combining PR4610’s changed warp geometry with a new entrance/first-contact chart for helper621 improves the supported conditional whole multiplication saving from **κ = 0.00302152 to κ = 0.00302156** (+0.00000004).

Helper621 starts in span `[30,429]`, and its first scalar contact uses that same chart. Regenerated climbs change the paid profile to `{1:2202,2:414,3:505,4:134,5:36,8:8}` and replace one rank-nine productive helper with an exact rank-seven relative target. The scalar word, logical warp maps, public endpoints and all 408 independent helper inputs are preserved. The complete whole-cost change is `18(H1 + 2H2 − H3 − H4 − H7 + H9)`, approximately −0.00401665923 at the tested exponent.

The package includes the frozen predecessor payload, a reproducible two-change construction, native and absolute-phase verification, and full arithmetic admission. The raw moment crossing `(0.0030215713, 0.0030215714)` is distinguished from the supported κ above. All inherited physical execution, precision, compiler, analytic and recovery premises remain conditional. This does not change the maintainer-selected certificate.

Attribution: Cao Yifan’s PR4610 at `4b4c75bc0fd64d3eee54029e8d2fab834251fca6` supplies the warp geometry and arithmetic starting point; Cinna Davis’s PR4470 and its credited predecessors supply the helper lattice and native contract. The vendored arithmetic changes its relative root lookup and reduces the tested-to-whole compiler gap from 1e-8 to 1e-9. The tested saving remains0.00302157; the larger finite compiler cutoff is N=2^337848000000000. Prepared by Pierre-Loic Doulcet with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Validation: fresh bidirectional replay on all 632 independent columns with two interpreters; all 2,865 paid/centre phase pairs, 72 logical warp operators on all 512 columns, actual warp classes and 408 helper normalizers; rejection controls; exact full-cost root, finite compiler and all 54 strict plus four functional outer checks. Package metadata, committed-byte and export-inventory checks pass. The complete registered Python3.12 replay passed at c665f908. The subsequent compiler-only retune leaves the native verifier and payload unchanged; fresh isolated/optimized arithmetic, independent54+4checks, source pins, committed-byte checks and Git-free exported arithmetic replay pass at the new head. Lean was not rerun; hosted CI is not claimed.

Hosted CI: the initial head c665f908 and current head e4413c43 both fail the same four shared documentation tests; current-head [run39771861497](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39771861497) again skips research replay. Initial run: [run39769537943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39769537943) fails in the shared onboarding tests before package selection; research replay is skipped. The four failures concern current-status/CI documentation: `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`, `test_current_section_matches_selected_record`, `test_history_banner_precedes_historical_sections`, and `test_only_the_first_heading_claims_current_or_selected`. A fresh scratch-only replay of the exact test and its document/record inputs from unchanged canonical main `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1` reproduces those same four failures (six tests, two pass). This PR changes only its new package; the complete registered local package replay passes. Hosted mathematical verification is not claimed.
